name: drawie-monorepo
//engines: Pin Node 22 (npm 10) for Vercel. Its Node 24 default ships npm 11, which hits the optional-dependency install bug (npm/cli#4828): on a fresh linux install npm 11 SKIPS @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu despite it being in the lockfile, so `vite build` dies with 'Cannot find module @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu'. npm 10 installs it. Vercel reads engines.node. Revisit when #4828 is fixed.
//workspaces: apps/native is intentionally EXCLUDED — it has React Native + react-native-skia deps that must not enter the web build's install. It installs independently (see apps/native/NATIVE_PLAN.md). Keep this list explicit rather than apps/* so adding the native app can't disturb the verified web workspace.
